title: Galat structure chuni to ghar bhi ja sakta hai
hooks: Galat structure chuni to ghar bhi ja sakta hai
Rahul ne Proprietorship liya, ab bank ghar pe notice bhej raha
30% tax ya 25%? Audit ka kharcha kaun jhelta hai?
hook_why: Direct threat to personal assets (ghar) in first 4 words matches the 'mistake warning' pattern; viewer instantly sees their own risk.
metaphor: Phone screen as decision tool: WhatsApp shows the problem, calculator shows tax math, notes show audit rules, final chat gives 3-question framework.

caption:
Galat structure chuni to ghar bhi ja sakta hai

Proprietorship = Tum aur business ek, unlimited liability
LLP = Liability limited, tax 30%, audit >40L turnover
Pvt Ltd = Tax ~25%, par har saal audit + ROC + CA fees

Apna risk, tax goal, funding need, compliance capacity — yeh 4 sawal puch lo.

Source: Income Tax Act 1961 (Sec 115BAA), LLP Act 2008, Companies Act 2013
Save karo, kaam aayega 📌

Tum kis situation mein ho? Comment mein batao
